Metadata.title: Bible Plan
Metadata.description: Create a Bible reading plan that fits your pace, with reading, prayer and meditation reminders.

hero.title: Read the Bible at your own pace, day after day.
hero.subtitle: Bible Plan builds a reading plan around your schedule, reminds you to read, pray and meditate, and helps you keep going, on your own or with others.
hero.verse: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

features.title: Everything you need to read consistently
features.subtitle: One app to grow in the Word, at your own pace.

plans.title: A plan that fits you
plans.description: The whole Bible in a year, the New Testament in 90 days or 15 minutes a day: readings are spread over the days you choose, and the plan adapts if you fall behind.

reminders.title: Reminders at the right time
reminders.description: A notification at the time you choose to read, pray or meditate, on your phone as well as on your computer.

prayer.title: Prayer and meditation
prayer.description: A journal for your prayer requests and answered prayers, a meditation timer and notes on what you read.

groups.title: Read together
groups.description: Follow a shared plan with your church, small group or family, share prayer requests and talk about the day’s reading.
